facts.value: OLAT (Online Learning and Training) is the central E-Learning platform of Goethe University.
BSCW (Basic Support for Cooperative Work) is a shared workspace system for cooperative work and project coordination.
Starker Start ins Studium offers a variety of workshops and advising options.
The Global Office has summarized important tips and tricks for a successful study at Goethe University.
The method week of Starker Start ins Studium offers the opportunity to acquire new methodological knowledge beyond the compulsory curricula of your studies.
The Best Practice series of FWWG regularly offers important methodological knowledge or soft skills on various topics.
Various institutions at Goethe University offer exam coaching.
The Library of Law and Economics (BRuW) at Campus Westend has extensive literature on all teaching and research areas of law and economics.
The Central Library at Campus Bockenheim offers additional services such as group workspaces and interlibrary loans.
There are 11 PC pool rooms available at Campus Westend for work, printing, or using study-specific software.
Information about the various functions of your HRZ account, such as Goethe Card, student email address, or WLAN, can be found on the pages of the university's computing center (HRZ).
